title: Weekly Charge for a Lot of Several Units in Storage
content:
# Weekly Charge for a Lot of Several Units in Storage

How many units of a project's scope stand in storage decides the weekly charge for the lot on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects, because units sharing a bay do not each occupy a full one.

**Where three or more units of the project's scope stand in storage**, the weekly charge for the lot is the weekly storage rate multiplied by the number of units standing in storage.

**Where two units stand in storage**, the weekly charge for the lot is the weekly storage rate multiplied by 1.5, the two units sharing one bay.

**Where one unit stands in storage**, the weekly charge for the lot is the weekly storage rate as it stands.

The number counted is the number of deliveries on the project recorded as stored because the site could not receive them.

## Illustration (hypothetical weekly storage rate of USD 200)

| Units standing in storage | Weekly charge for the lot |
|---|---|
| 1 | USD 200 |
| 2 | USD 300 |
| 3 | USD 600 |
| 4 | USD 800 |

Two units come to one and a half bays rather than two, which is why the lot of two is charged at USD 300 and not USD 400; from three units upward every unit counts in full.
